XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Inactive cabin heating and flashing temperature display
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: AIR CONDITIONING | CONVEYOR | HEATING | B1902 | B1906 | B1905 | INACTIVE | NOT | WORKING | VENTS | PERMANENT | COLD | COLD | SINGLE | ZONE | HOT | HOT | FLASHING | INTERMITTENT | DISPLAY | SCREEN | INDICATOR | SINGLE ZONE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with an automatic air-conditioning system

  • System: Air-conditioning system

  • Component: Air conditioning blower

  • Fault: Cabin heating not working and temperature indicator on the display flashing

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following
    • B1902 (Cabin air distribution motor – Wiring fault)
    • B1906 (Cabin air mixing motor – Wiring fault)
    • B1905 (Cabin air mixing motor feedback signal – Wiring fault)
  • Cause: Faulty air conditioning duct

• Action: Replace the air conditioning/heating conveyor

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, the conveyor malfunction was due to a broken mixing motor pin.
    No reprogramming via the self-diagnostic tester was necessary after replacement.
